title: Remove the runner-dispatch embedded fallback entirely (runnerDispatchFallbackMs)
goal:
Completely remove the embedded-execution fallback for runner-servable stages so the backend NEVER spawns an in-process agent.

Context: KAINBAIN_RUNNER_EXECUTION_ONLY=1 defers agent stages to the runner fleet, but KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS (default 90000ms) makes executeStage fall back to embedded execution after the wait ceiling (api/flow/dispatch/isRunnerDispatchFallbackDue.js, used by the defer gate in api/flow/execution/executeStage.js; config key runnerDispatchFallbackMs in api/config/schema.js). The backend runs in a Docker container with NO provider credentials and no harness CLIs, so any fallback run fails: on 2026-11-13 task 1c91140c stage catchup (alias utility) waited 103s unclaimed, fell back at 18:48:00Z, and burned 5/5 retries with "No API key found for mistral" / "spawn agy ENOENT" / "spawn muse ENOENT" before parking.

Interim mitigation already applied in prod: KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS=0 in /home/server/apps/kainbain/.env (verified via /api/system/config-spec: value 0, source env).

Scope of removal:
- Delete api/flow/dispatch/isRunnerDispatchFallbackDue.js (+ its test) and the fallback branch in the executeStage defer gate.
- Remove the runnerDispatchFallbackMs key from api/config/schema.js (and any docs/env coverage referencing KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS).
- Decide the starvation story explicitly: with the fallback gone, runner-only mode means tasks wait indefinitely for a capable runner; make sure queue visibility/alerting covers that (wedge/queue-empty paths already exist), or pair this with a loud ALERT rather than silent waiting.
- Keep embedded behavior only for the cases that must stay embedded: human checkpoints, CI/command stages, unresolvable aliases, circuit-canary probes.
- Update tests that exercise the fallback (executeStage/defer-gate suites) to assert the new hard-defer behavior.

## Follow-up Guidance
Update from investigation (2026-11-13 ~21:20Z): the fallback is not only the 90s wall-clock one — the deployed gate also has Check 2 in executeStage: when isRunnerClaimable() finds NO active fresh runner matching the task right now (e.g. all heartbeats stale after backend 502s, or a runner crashed mid-claim with stale-execution), it falls back to embedded IMMEDIATELY, regardless of runnerDispatchFallbackMs. Concrete failure this causes today: the wf-default Update stage (ci, runOnBranch=primary, runnerPolicy allow local-alpha/local-bravo) runs `cd /home/server/apps/kainbain && ./update.sh`. When it falls back, that runs inside the backend CONTAINER, which mounts only /home/server/projects and /home/server/.kainbain — NOT /home/server/apps — so it dies with: /bin/sh: cd: cant cd to /home/server/apps/kainbain: No such file or directory (exit 2). Observed embedded (source=process-log, no runnerId) failures: task e597e05b 2026-11-12T02:00:35Z, 55460086 2026-11-12T11:51:24Z, 94ee5786 2026-11-13T20:22:41Z, 99ccc12f 2026-11-13T20:29:31Z (runner local-alpha claimed it at 20:29:16, went stale-execution at 20:29:29 and crashed; backend ran it embedded 2s later). The Publish stage itself succeeds (registry push + dist, exit 0); it is the follow-on Update stage that fails. Removal scope must therefore cover BOTH fallback checks (wall-clock isRunnerDispatchFallbackDue AND the no-capable-runner isRunnerClaimable fallback), not just the 90s timer. Interim mitigation in prod already sets KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS=0, which only disables the wall-clock check — Check 2 still fires. Defense-in-depth option: mount /home/server/apps into the backend container; durable fix is removing the fallback entirely so CI/agent stages only ever run on runners.

1|# Implementation Plan – Remove embedded-execution fallback for runner-servable stages
2|
3|Task: `7b5a1bd8-9455-43e5-95d6-698a2dc7f782`
4|Date: 2026-11-13
5|Related: `SURVEY.md` (round 1 answers), follow-up guidance 2026-11-13 ~21:20Z
6|
7|## 1. Purpose
8|
9|Completely remove the backend's ability to run a runner-servable stage in-process.
10|After this change `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_EXECUTION_ONLY=1` (the default) becomes a
11|true hard defer: servable agent/CI/remote-merge stages return
12|`deferred: "runner-dispatch"` and wait for a capable runner indefinitely.
13|No 90-second wall-clock fallback and no "no capable runner right now" immediate
14|fallback may run the work inside the container.
15|
16|Embedded execution remains the correct behavior for:
17|
18|- human checkpoints (`review` normalizes to `human`);
19|- CI/command (`ci`) stages when the runner gate is off (`KAINBAIN_RUNNER_EXECUTION_ONLY=false`),
20|  during circuit-canary probes, or for unresolvable aliases;
21|- unresolvable alias agent stages (dispatch is not servable, so they use the embedded path);
22|- circuit-canary probes (canary bypass preserved for the half-open probe);
23|- local-only merge stages (`hasUpstreamRepo !== true`).
24|
25|## 2. Decisions adopted from the grill-me survey (`SURVEY.md`)
26|
27|| Survey question | Decision |
28||---|---|
29|| Q1 embedded fallback ever? | No — hard defer always. Note from survey: removing the backend *capability*, not a local runner. |
30|| Q2 alerting beyond queue view? | Existing queue chip/popup + scheduler stats (`deferredDispatch`, `lastOutcome`) is sufficient. No recurring alert. |
31|| Q3 wf-default Update command? | No mount or fallback change; runs on a runner honoring `runOnBranch` / runner whitelist (`local-alpha`/`local-bravo`). |
32|| Q4 tests with no runner? | Always defer, even empty registry / stale fleet. |
33|| Q5 `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS`? | Fully remove key, docs, `.env.example` references. Unknown/legacy value present in env must not error. |
34|| Q6 `isRunnerClaimable` helper? | Keep helper and its tests (dispatch/future use). Never wire it back into the defer decision. |
35|
36|## 3. Success criteria (acceptance)
37|
38|1. `api/flow/dispatch/isRunnerDispatchFallbackDue.js` and its test are deleted.
39|2. `api/flow/execution/executeStage.js` never imports or calls `isRunnerDispatchFallbackDue`,
40|   `isRunnerClaimable`, `resolveAliasRequirement`, or `taskRequirements` for the gate.
41|   When `config.runnerExecutionOnly !== false`, not a canary, and
42|   `isDispatchServable(...)` is true, `executeStage` returns `deferred: "runner-dispatch"`
43|   unconditionally — including empty registry, stale fleet, and "enteredStageAt 2 min ago".
44|3. `runnerDispatchFallbackMs` is absent from `api/config/schema.js` and
45|   `api/config/config.test.js` expected defaults; `CONFIG_SCHEMA` keys and defaults still
46|   match (loader equality tests).
47|4. `.env.example` no longer documents `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS`.
48|5. `docs/EngineDetails/TaskQueueing.md` no longer describes the two embedded fallbacks;
49|   it states runner-only hard defer and the starvation operator story.
50|6. Updated tests assert hard-defer in all capability-miss/stale-clock situations.
51|7. `npm run test:unit` passes for touched suites.
52|8. `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_MS=90000` left in an old env file produces no warning/error
53|   from `loadConfig` (unknown env is ignored by construction).
54|
55|## 4. Risk & rollback
56|
57|- Risk: tasks behind a fleet with zero capable runners now wait forever instead of
58|  silently failing inside the container. Mitigation: scheduler stats make this visible
59|  (`deferredDispatch`, `lastOutcome = deferred-runner-dispatch`); operator runbook
60|  (section 10) documents recovery; emergency rollback `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_EXECUTION_ONLY=false`.
61|- Risk: a test or caller still reads `config.runnerDispatchFallbackMs`. Mitigation: grep
62|  gate in verification (section 8).
63|- Rollback: revert the single PR; no persisted state/schema migration is involved.
64|  Fallback helpers/tests can be restored from git history if ever needed.
